purpose: Teach: エクアドル/リトル/リバー/ツイン/ニフティ/ポリス/サンデー/バックス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エクアドルのバナナを取り寄せてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer orders Ecuadorian bananas regularly, I noticed.
lines.style: Soft, musing tone. Sharing an observation gently, as if placing a small gift on a table. Warm, no urgency. Slight pause before speaking, like turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リトルリーグの監督されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh? Your customer coaches Little League, doesn't he.
lines.style: Gently curious, a small smile in the voice. Not quite a question — more like Aoi is delighted by the discovery. Quiet acknowledgment, inviting Mei to continue.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リバーサイドのジムに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer works out at Riverside Gym, I think.
lines.style: Calm, observational. Speaking as if remembering something she'd noticed before. Tender curiosity underneath. No pressure to respond — just offering the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ツインタワーの夜景写真がご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He loves photographing the Twin Towers at night, doesn't he.
lines.style: Softly delighted, like she's pieced something together. Warm recognition in her tone. The slight lilt of wonder — she finds this detail charming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ニフティのフォーラム時代から友達だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You two have been friends since the Nifty forum days, haven't you.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Speaking gently, like she's connecting the threads. A touch of tenderness — recognizing something long and real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ザ・ポリスの曲がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's a big fan of The Police, isn't he.
lines.style: Soft, almost amused observation. Like she's remembering something she heard him mention. Warm, easy — not probing, just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サンデーモーニングの番組を毎週観られるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You watch Sunday Morning every week without fail.
lines.style: Calm statement, spoken with quiet affection. Not a question — a knowing recognition of something about Aoi herself. Gentle, no judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラグビーのバックスの動きを研究されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You study how the rugby backs move, don't you.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely impressed. Speaking as if she's just understood something deeper about him. The tone lingers with quiet admiration. Trailing warmth at the close.
